questions.question: / aur // me fark?
questions.answer: / true division deta hai aur normally float result deta hai. // floor division quotient ka floor deta hai.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: % operator kaha use hota hai?
questions.answer: Remainder nikalne ke liye. Even/odd, cycle aur divisibility checks me bahut useful hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: == aur is me fark?
questions.answer: == value equality dekhta hai. is object identity dekhta hai - same object hai ya nahi.
questions.explanation: See model answer.

questions.question: and, or, not kya karte hain?
questions.answer: and me sab conditions true chahiye, or me ek true kaafi hai, not boolean result ko invert karta hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Operator precedence kya hai?
questions.answer: Ye decide karta hai kaun pehle evaluate hoga. Doubt ho to parentheses use karna readable aur safe hota hai.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo.

questions.question: Short-circuit evaluation kya hai?
questions.answer: and/or result jaldi pata chalne par baaki expression evaluate nahi karte. Isse unnecessary work aur kuch errors avoid hote hain.
questions.explanation: TIP: 20-30 sec me clearly bolo. Mini speaking drill: Har answer bina PDF dekhe 2 baar bolo. Dusri baar ek real example add karo.
